description: Number literals that may stay in main.tex prose because they are names or identifiers, not quantities. Every other number in main.tex must be a macro from generated_numbers.tex (scripts/eval/checkManuscriptNumbers.js). Each entry needs a justification; add an entry only for a phrase whose digits are not a measured, computed or configured value.

entries.justification: Identifier of a verification policy (a name), defined in config/verificationPolicy.js POLICY_IDS; the digits are a version label, not a quantity. Added 2026-10-16 when the manuscript was aligned with ADR-022.
